summary: Added a compact calibration ladder for composite beneficiary-side netting, clarifying how to order several real outward-flow slices once and tax only the retained exceptional residual without double-netting.
north_star: Protect the human floor; tax rents, harms, bottlenecks, inheritances, extraction, and automation-linked windfalls before routine labor; keep current AI controller-routed rather than directly person-taxed; keep nonhuman animals and ecological commons on the protected side by taxing upstream harms; treat copies, prompts, thin resale, white-labeling, outside oversight, risk finance, passive infrastructure, tools, and ordinary input supply as non-dispositive for controller status; let durable governance, continuation power, and residual upside identify real controllers; and if future artificial personhood ever becomes real, switch fully to ordinary person-side logic rather than mixing ownership with civic liability.
core_claims: Subsistence should be untaxed or negatively taxed.
Land, natural-resource rents, inheritance, monopoly, pollution, and comparable concentrated advantages should be taxed before routine labor.
Broad consumption taxes should usually be paired with visible rebates or transfers rather than exemption forests.

For human taxation, ordinary earnings liability should default to the individual person, while dependents and caregivers are recognized through transfers, services, and carefully bounded means tests rather than compulsory jointness.
Current LLMs are tax-relevant technologies, not direct tax persons.

Species or substrate is not itself a rate base: current non-person systems stay controller-routed, while any future rights-bearing artificial persons would enter the ordinary person regime without a substrate surcharge.
Present-day LLM taxation should be controller-first: facility, lab, deployer, beneficiary, bottleneck, and externality before any fantasy of direct machine civic liability.

Nonhuman animals and ecological commons belong on the protected side of the ledger rather than the remitter side, so taxation should target human-controlled harms, extraction, pollution, confinement, and privileged access upstream.

Copies, forks, fine-tunes, and swarms of current machine systems increase measured activity or avoidance risk, not civic person-count; group them by real control unless independent rights-bearing standing is actually present.

Ordinary prompting, ordinary hosted use, thin resale, delegated operation, outside oversight, ordinary risk finance, ordinary commercial channel intermediation, ordinary third-party tool or API provision, ordinary training-input supply, and mere white-label branding do not by themselves make a downstream actor, the state, a reviewer, an insurer, a billing intermediary, an execution-rail provider, a branded seller, or a corpus / benchmark supplier the upstream AI controller; where several actors each look partly controller-like, primary status follows durable governance, continuation power, and residual upside, genuinely shared governance still routes through the real controller group, version resets or affiliate transfers do not by themselves erase controller continuity, and real downstream customization, orchestration, retrieval governance, tool permissioning, safety-policy control, inside-the-loop action governance, training / release gate control, mission-specific commissioning, real public-body deployment, or other real discretionary governance can still create co-controller duties for the governed layer, while real step-in command can temporarily create controller duties for the layer and period actually placed under live operational control.

When several classes, contexts, or species rules overlap, resolve them by precedence — subjecthood and protected-side vetoes first, then floor protection and catastrophic-risk gating, then real controller / beneficial-owner grouping, then base ordering, scale assignment, incidence, and only then timing, measurement, and rates.

Passive clouds, utilities, landlords, lenders, and contract hosts can be rent targets, remittance anchors, or host-burden payers without automatically becoming the primary AI controller; escalate to controller treatment only when they materially allocate capacity, govern deployment risk, or can decide whether the high-impact activity proceeds.

Static open-weight publication does not create endless controller liability, but maintained hubs, gated distribution, update channels, ranking power, or continuing release governance can justify bounded upstream duties without displacing deployment-specific liability from actual deployers and major beneficiaries.

Special AI levies need an exceptional trigger such as local burden, scarce-capacity appropriation, concentrated bottleneck rent, automation-linked windfall, or bounded public-input reciprocity; most cases still route controller-side, but some large downstream winners can owe bounded beneficiary-side contributions without being mislabeled as controllers.

If a future artificial system ever genuinely crosses into rights-bearing personhood, ownership must end and taxation must switch as a bundle to ordinary person-regime logic with floor protection, standing, remedy, representation, and no machine-species surcharge.
Statutory remittance does not settle moral burden-bearing; final incidence must be checked explicitly.

Collection should usually begin at the strongest intermediary, registry, or controller-side anchor that already sees the taxable flow or asset, while keeping relief and correction at least as low-friction as collection itself, returning undisputed overcollection promptly, keeping any setoff narrow, mature, and visible, keeping heavy proof burdens with the strongest record-holder and shifting contested hidden facts toward superior-access actors rather than weak downstream actors, while harder adverse inference belongs mainly to strategic opacity or spoliation, refusing private terms that try to waive protected relief or dump public duties downstream, keeping ordinary civic access off exclusive one-bank, one-app, one-vendor, one-device, or one-identity-rail designs, and separating correction, interest, civil penalty, upstream-enabler sanction, and rare criminal referral rather than collapsing every failure into one punitive lane. Thresholds should usually slope rather than cliff, with hard cutoffs reserved for genuinely categorical duties and buffered transitions.

Administration is constitutional substance: serious liabilities should be machine-readable but human-auditable, with disclosed rule versions, measured bases, key data sources or proxies, real correction / appeal lanes, narrow claims where the rule needs only threshold facts, reusable credentials where facts are already proved, same-facts reuse plus bounded deltas before repeated full refiling, targeted stays or bounded escrow before weak-side pay-first review, purpose-bounded matching rather than raw-data defaulting, and material adverse model-assisted action carried by a minimum auditable packet plus real non-rubber-stamp human review, while controller maps name accountable signers, stay correction-first and retention-bounded, preserve controller-relevant evidence on ordinary cadence or dispute-triggered hold, and verify contested controller claims through proportionate cross-checks or event samples rather than packet worship or universal deep audit, while measurement honesty still requires observable bases, scheduled revaluation, disclosed proxies, and narrow safe harbors over fake precision.
Payment timing is part of tax justice: use withholding, instalments, deferral, liens, and ex ante reserves where liquidity or risk timing would otherwise distort the moral design.

A morally serious tax should treat gains and losses as one fiscal relationship: genuine downside should be recognized through netting, value-preserving carry-forwards, bounded carry-backs, refundability where justified, or ex ante reserves where catastrophe rather than ordinary business risk is the real issue.

Nominal values are not moral values: brackets, credits, loss relief, basis rules, bonds, reserve minima, and thresholds should be indexed, honestly approximated, or openly re-set rather than allowed to drift into stealth redistribution through inflation.

Taxes are not always the first instrument: use taxes mainly for revenue, rent capture, and priceable harms; use transfers and services for floor protection; use explicit subsidy or public provision for capacity-building; use bonds, reserves, or insurance for prefunding; and use approval, caps, or refusal where catastrophic or non-compensable risk would make tax-as-permit a category mistake.

Scale assignment is part of tax justice: put immovable bases and local burdens where they sit, keep person-level floors broadly pooled, and use coordinated destination or market rules plus club floors for mobile rents and AI-era cross-border profit.

Large downstream winners do not escape the beneficiary lane merely by invoking debt service, premium or risk-pool rhetoric, site-rent absorption, discretionary philanthropy, or self-directed reinvestment; only real outside creditor, policyholder, site-rent, or irrevocable public-benefit transfer, or genuinely locked prefunding for outside or public obligations, narrows that lane, while ordinary leverage, captive insurance, affiliate debt, related landlords, donor-controlled giving, capex rhetoric, and optional reserve building stay on their own routes, and mixed charitable cases should net only the truly outside irrevocable slice before taxing the retained exceptional residual, and where several outward-flow stories are simultaneously real the same dollar should be netted once in duty-first order before taxing the retained residual.
